rows.abstract: Rationale: Due to the lack of adequate funding and the necessary technical assistance at the early stage of implementation of the Local Government Code, most local government units encountered difficulties in assuming the devolved health functions and responsibilitie s. rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 13 OR REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3019 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE `ANTI-GRAFT AND CORRUPT PRACTICES ACT'(RE: PREVENTIVE SUSPENSION OF INCUMBENT PUBLIC OFFICER...)
rows.abstract: Regarding the SUSPENSION of an incumbent public officer, this bill states that THE PREVENTIVE SUSPENSION OF SUCH INCUMBENT PUBLIC OFFICER FOR ANY SINGLE CASE SHALL NOT EXTEND BEYOND A PERIOD OF SIXTY (60) DAYS. PROVIDED FURTHER THAT IN CASE THE INCUMBENT PUBLIC OFFICER HAS BEEN CHARGED FOR MORE THAN ONE VIOLATION, HE CANNOT BE PREVENTIVELY SUSPENDED FOR MORE THAN NINETY (90) DAYS WITHIN A SINGLE YEAR ON THE SAME GROUND OR GROUNDS EXISTING AT THE TIME OF THE FIRST SUSPENSION.

rows.author: C099
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING CABINET SECRETARIES, UNDERSECRETARIE S OR ANY APPOINTIVE OFFICIAL WITH EQUIVALENT RANK OR EMOLUMENT, IN ORDER TO BE ELIGIBLE TO RUN FOR ANY ELECTIVE OFFICE, TO RESIGN FROM OFFICE ONE YEAR PRIOR TO FILING OF THEIR CERTIFICATE OF CANDIDACY OR TO WAIT FOR A PRESCRIBED PERIOD OF ONE (1) YEAR FROM THE DATE OF RESIGNATION, REMOVAL OR COMPLETION OF TERM OF OFFICE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Rationale: This bill is designed primarily to remove any possibility of an appointive official having to face a conflict of interest between his Cabinet position and his own political agenda.  Withi this bill, the appointed official can focus on implementing programs under his department or office without regard for his own political plans or agenda, thereby removing any speculation that the appointive official is using his office to support his own election campaign.

rows.abstract: This bill refers to the preventive suspension of any officer or employee under the authority of the Ombudsman. rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH AND MAINTAIN LACTATION STATIONS IN WORKPLACES FOR WORKING MOTHERS BREAST-FEEDING THEIR INFANTS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Workplace Lactation Act of 2000".  It is hereby mandated that employers whether government agencies, including its subdivisions, instrumentaliti es and government-owne d and-controlled corporations, or private enterprises with women employees shallmaintain lactation stations in the workplaces to  promote breast-feeding of new-born infants until the age of two years. Such lactations stations shall consist of (a) lavatory for hand-washing; (b) hot plate and casserole for sterilizing individually-ow ned manual breast pumps; and (c) refrigerator for storing pumped breast milk.
